info.description: MVP multi-tenant event platform. Auth owns user identity; org membership and permissions live in organization/iam.
info.title: Rallya API

get.description: QR payloads arrive by confirmation email (raw tokens are hash-only at rest and cannot be re-issued here).
QR payloads arrive by confirmation email (hash-only storage cannot re-issue them).

post.description: Flips to CANCELLED (audit trail kept).
Invalidates prior reset tokens and emails a 1h single-use link if the account exists. Always returns 200.

200.description: If the email exists, a reset link was sent

post.description: Verifies the bcrypt password, enforces ACTIVE status + verified email, then returns an access JWT and a rotating refresh token.
Revokes the session bound to the access token plus its refresh rows.

get.description: Returns id, email, verification flag, profile names, and org memberships for the access-token owner.

post.description: Single-use rotation: the presented token is revoked and a new pair issued. Reuse triggers session-wide revocation.
Creates the identity, hashes the password with bcrypt, and emails a 24h verification link. Login is blocked until verified.
Issues a fresh 24h verification token. Throttled (60s). Unknown emails still return 200 to avoid enumeration.
Single-use 1h token. On success all sessions + refresh tokens are revoked.
Confirms email ownership with the 6-digit code from the verification email. Codes expire after 10 minutes and allow 5 attempts.
Confirms email ownership. Tokens are single-use and expire after 24h.

get.description: Public discovery across orgs, filterable and paginated.
Public detail by UUID. Drafts/cancelled return 404.

post.description: Claims inventory atomically; free orders confirm immediately, priced wait for payments. Idempotent via idempotencyKey.

get.description: Active types with live availability. No purchase flow yet (orders module).
Owners see their own; org admins via support path. Others get 404.

post.description: Releases held inventory. Terminal states rejected. Priced refunds arrive with payments.
Returns a hosted Checkout Session URL for a priced order awaiting payment. Free orders 400 (nothing to pay).

get.description: Orgs the caller belongs to, with roles. Used for org switching and GET /auth/me bootstrap.

post.description: Creates a tenant org; the caller becomes OWNER.
Caller account email must match the invite. Creates the membership; idempotent for members.
Rejects a pending invite addressed to the caller. Idempotent; accepted invites cannot be declined.

get.description: Org details; :id accepts UUID or slug. Non-members get 404.

delete.description: Hard delete; memberships and invites cascade.

patch.description: Rename / re-slug / logo. Slug conflicts return 409.

get.description: Paginated, filterable; includes drafts for members.

post.description: Creates a DRAFT event under the org; slug auto-uniquifies per org.

get.description: Drafts require membership; :eventId accepts UUID or slug.

patch.description: Field updates; status changes go through publish/unpublish/cancel.

get.description: Paginated with name/email search. No QR payloads (door use only).

post.description: Walk-ins, comps, staff. Email need not belong to an account.
PUBLISHED → CANCELLED (terminal).
QR string or roster attendee ID. Refusals return 200 with their outcome.
QR-only, per-item outcomes, no fail-fast. Max 50 codes.

get.description: Registered / checked-in / cancelled tallies for one event.

post.description: Multipart file (jpeg/png/webp, 5MB max, content-sniffed). Replaces existing cover.

get.description: All uploaded images with provider metadata, oldest first.

post.description: Multipart files[] (up to 10, jpeg/png/webp, 5MB each, content-sniffed). When the event has no cover yet, the first image becomes the cover.
DRAFT → PUBLISHED; queues announcements to opted-in members.

get.description: All types incl. drafts, with live availability.

post.description: Prices one admission tier; starts DRAFT. Capacity coupling enforced both ways.

delete.description: Only with zero sales; sold history survives.

patch.description: Quantity cuts below sold and capacity violations rejected.

post.description: DRAFT/PAUSED → ACTIVE.
ACTIVE → PAUSED (reversible; distinct from computed SOLD_OUT).
PUBLISHED → DRAFT.
Creates a 7d invite and queues the invite email. Supersedes pending invites for the email.

get.description: Paginated memberships with identity display data.

post.description: Adds a registered user; use invites for non-registered emails.

patch.description: Opt in or out of publish announcement emails for this org.

delete.description: ADMIN+ may remove MEMBER/ADMIN; only OWNER removes OWNER. Self-leave allowed except last OWNER.

patch.description: Demoting the last OWNER is rejected.

post.description: Signature-verified fulfillment endpoint. Send raw event JSON with a valid Stripe-Signature header.

organizations.description: Organizations is omitted when no membership integration is wired.
